Shrouded Fable

Released August 2, 2024 · 99 cards

StandardExpanded

Shrouded Fable is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on August 2, 2024. Its main set has 64 cards, plus 35 secret rares numbered beyond the set (99 in total). It includes 79 Pokémon, 18 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

69 illustrators worked on Shrouded Fable. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (4), kantaro (4), aky CG Works (3), GOSSAN (3), James Turner (3), takuyoa (3), Atsushi Furusawa (2), AYUMI ODASHIMA (2).
